title: The effect of theta tACS on working memory
description: This dataset examines the effects of theta transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) on working memory performance and associated EEG activity. Participants received either verum or sham 20-minute tACS at 1 mA and 6 Hz over Fpz-CPz, followed by working memory tasks requiring mental manipulation or retention of memory items, while EEG was recorded. Resting-state EEG (eyes closed and eyes open) was also collected prior to the working memory task.
methods_description: Participants underwent 20 minutes of verum or sham tACS applied to Fpz-CPz at 1 mA and 6 Hz. EEG was recorded during working memory tasks requiring participants to mentally manipulate or retain memory items, as well as during resting-state periods with eyes closed (3 minutes) and eyes open (1.5 minutes) prior to the task.
